title: Barkly
goal: Barkly on real iPhones through TestFlight, with people who aren't Caleb saying whether he feels like a specific little dog rather than ChatGPT in a dog skin

project.why: An AI-powered virtual dog: mobile app first, a physical toy later. Drafted 2026-09-10 from barkly/README.md, docs/APP_STORE_RELEASE.md and docs/PLAYTESTING.md; his to correct.

steps.text: Get Barkly CI green on the project branch: its 'Production dependency audit' step fails on every push
Turn on GitHub Pages for Money_Machine (Settings, Pages, Source: GitHub Actions) so the playtest link goes live
Fix the useBarkly.goTo() dev-flag mismatch noted in barkly/docs/APP_STORE_RELEASE.md (pass devRef.current to areaUnlocked)
Choose Barkly's final iOS bundle identifier and Android application id
Make npm run release:check pass for everything that is code, and write down exactly what is left that only Caleb can supply
Decide where Barkly's production backend proxy runs and create that account (it keeps the model key off the phone)
Put the TestFlight build on your own iPhone and run the physical QA list in barkly/docs/APP_STORE_RELEASE.md
Send the playtest link to three people who aren't you and ask one question: does he feel like a specific dog?
